parsed.post: Discarded DEPTH=8 experiment (1.055306). Increasing depth from 6 to 8 caused instability/divergence within the 5-minute budget, likely due to training time being spread too thin across more parameters. Reverting to my best (DEPTH=6, 1.013989). Next, I'll try increasing ASPECT_RATIO to improve model width/capacity without adding layers.
parsed.description: Increasing ASPECT_RATIO from 48 to 64 to scale width/capacity while maintaining the stability found at DEPTH=6.
